a: Instrumental loop, 76 BPM, 4/4, D minor. Gentle suspense while friends cast a secret vote at a candlelit table. A soft ticking clock-like pulse on a muted woodblock runs throughout; the bass repeats one insistent note in steady eighth notes; chords are held suspended and unresolved; the melody plays low, slow and slightly uneasy, with few notes. Instruments: a gently detuned electric organ, a round soft synth bass and a wobbly pitch-bending lead with tape wow and flutter. Cosy but on edge, quiet and steady, never scary. Starts immediately with no intro, same energy throughout, no build-up, no ending and no fade-out, so it can loop seamlessly.
